    lin_expr += 2.82 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.54, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 9.55 * vars['Var_3']

    lin_expr += 9.47 * vars['Var_6']

    m.addConstr(1.82 * vars['Var_0'] + 2.68 * vars['Var_1'] + 8.21 * vars['Var_4'] + -1.84 * vars['Var_5'] <= 5.06, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(3.41 * vars['Var_0'] + 9.96 * vars['Var_2'] + 5.78 * vars['Var_3'] + -0.41 * vars['Var_4'] + 2.07 * vars['Var_5'] + 6.71 * vars['Var_6'] <= 156.32, name='C3')
    m.addConstr(-0.97 * vars['Var_0'] + 5.07 * vars['Var_4'] + 1.51 * vars['Var_5'] + -4.64 * vars['Var_6'] <= 7.54, name='C4')
    m.addConstr(7.28 * vars['Var_0'] + 3.4 * vars['Var_1'] + 7.76 * vars['Var_2'] + 8.36 * vars['Var_3'] + -1.02 * vars['Var_4'] + 6.63 * vars['Var_5'] + 1.84 * vars['Var_6'] <= 161.87, name='C5')
    m.addConstr(5.57 * vars['Var_1'] + 1.07 * vars['Var_4'] + -2.65 * vars['Var_6'] <= -4.29, name='C6')
